Dear Friend,

Thank you for adding your voice to our movement. By joining the GLAAD family, you’re showing the world that you support love, acceptance, and the freedom to safely live the life you love.

For nearly 40 years, GLAAD has stood on the forefront of the fight for LGBTQ equality. Our core programs nurture and inspire cultural understanding, prove that inclusive and positive representation matters, and work to shatter stigma and discrimination—one LGBTQ narrative, image, and character at a time.

By signing up for email, you will receive regular updates about current events, GLAAD’s work, and actions you can take to create change. If you want to do even more to accelerate acceptance now, please make a gift today. Your donation will be rushed into action to help us create a safe world in which all of us can live as our authentic selves.

Thank you again. Together we’re accelerating 100% acceptance.
 

With Kind Regards,

GLAAD Donor Services
